plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs to zero.
Exit remaining high-beta, leveraged software/semis.
Reduce income ETF (QQQI) to 20%.
Hold broad index (SPY/QQQ) and quality names.
Maintain a significant cash buffer.
Focus on capital preservation and low drawdowns.
conservative.read: This plan prioritizes capital preservation. Expect modest returns, around 1.5% per month, with significantly reduced risk and drawdowns. It aims for stability over aggressive growth.

plan: Reduce exposure to most leveraged ETFs to minimal levels.
Trim remaining leveraged software and semiconductor ETFs.
Slightly reduce income ETF (QQQI) to 25%.
Add a new, high-scoring scanner setup (ERY) for potential growth.
Maintain a moderate cash buffer.
Balance growth potential with risk management.
balanced.read: This balanced approach aims for risk-first growth, targeting around 2.5% per month. It blends broad market exposure with quality tech and a small allocation to new opportunities, while keeping leverage and concentration in check.

plan: Reduce income ETF (QQQI) to 25%.
Increase allocations to leveraged software and semiconductor ETFs.
Add new leveraged ETFs (SPAL) and strong scanner setups (ERY).
Concentrate exposure in high-conviction, leveraged names.
Maintain a smaller cash buffer.
Embrace higher potential returns with increased risk and drawdown.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets significant growth, around 4% per month, by leaning into leverage and concentration. It carries substantially higher risk, including larger potential drawdowns and the effects of leveraged ETF decay. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs to zero.
Exit all high-beta, leveraged software and semiconductor positions.
Increase allocation to income-focused ETF (QQQI) to 30%.
Prioritize steady monthly distributions over growth.
Maintain a cash buffer for stability.
Focus on minimizing drawdowns and generating reliable income.
income.read: This income-focused plan aims for steady monthly distributions, targeting around 1% per month. It prioritizes capital preservation and low volatility over aggressive growth. While distributions are not guaranteed, the strategy seeks to provide reliable income with reduced risk.
